svg.text: Each row is one folder under src/production_rag/methods/, with its flow and what it does.
Fixed 800-char chunks, dense top 5, one prompt, generate
Files to Markdown, then fixed, recursive, heading-aware or
An LLM sentence per chunk places it in its document, embedded
A yes/no LLM check per hazard before any search
Several phrasings of the question, results merged
A hypothetical answer passage replaces the question for dense
The question plus one more general question, merged by best
A multi-part question split into up to 3 sub-questions
BM25 without IDF, with IDF, and with Vietnamese stopwords
Reciprocal rank fusion, distribution-based fusion, or weighted
Hybrid RRF, then a cross-encoder over the top candidates
An LLM scores the top 20 dense results, the best 5 are kept
Neighbour chunks or the full document around each hit
An LLM keeps only the sentences that help answer the question
An LLM says whether the top 5 passages are enough to answer
Claims, evidence per claim, verdict: supported, refuted,
